topic: Handling faulty facility data and forecasting
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on addressing facilities with problematic data originating from AFA. [p1] requested a forecast to be generated for the routers associated with these faulty data sources, followed by re-uploading that data into jcd.

[me] confirmed that a list of affected facilities is available in an existing Jira ticket (DOOH-1809).
decisions: A forecast must be created for routers providing faulty data.
The generated forecast data needs to be re-uploaded into jcd.
action_items: Someone needs to notify the relevant parties when communication regarding this issue is required.
